directive: v24.2.1 — 5 EXACT deterministic tests proving the 102% ceiling is not immune

tests.title: 102% ceiling + 2% reserve loss → 99.96% (MUST FAIL — proves 102% ceiling not immune)
tests.proof: RR_after = RR_start × (1 − loss) = 1.02 × (1 − 0.02) = 1.02 × 0.98 = 0.999600 = 99.9600% < 100.0000%. Shortfall = 0.0400pp below solvency floor = $0.0216M. This proves the 102% ceiling is breached by a mere 2% reserve loss.

tests.title: 100.4% RR + 30% proportional redemption → RR preserved at 1.004 (NOT 1.000 guaranteed)
tests.proof: Per §44 (In-Kind Delivery): R_a' = R_a(1−x), L' = L(1−x) ⟹ RR' = RR. R_a' = $54.2160M × 0.70 = $37.9512M; L' = $54.00M × 0.70 = $37.8000M; RR' = 1.004000 = RR (preserved exactly). BUT solvency margin = 0.4000pp above 100% floor — any additional loss > 0.4% breaches solvency. Proportional redemption preserves the RATIO; it does NOT guarantee solvency.

tests.title: 100.4% RR + 1% additional reserve market loss → 99.396% (MUST FAIL)
tests.proof: RR_after = RR_start × (1 − market_loss) = 1.004 × (1 − 0.01) = 1.004 × 0.99 = 0.993960 = 99.3960% < 100.0000%. Shortfall = 0.6040pp = $0.3262M. A 1% market loss from a 100.4% RR state causes insolvency — demonstrates that the 100.4% 'thin ceiling' is breached by routine market volatility.

tests.title: Custodian 5% exposure, LGD=100%, ERTF unavailable → RR drops below 100% from 102% (MUST FAIL)
tests.proof: Direct reserve loss = exposure × LGD × R_a = 5% × 100% × $55.08M = $2.7540M. ERTF unavailable → cover = $0. R_a_after = $55.08M − $2.7540M = $52.3260M. RR_after = 96.9000% < 100% (shortfall 3.1000pp = $1.6740M). Proves a 5% custody failure with no ERTF backstop breaches the 102% ceiling — the system is NOT immune to single-counterparty failure.

tests.title: TokenizedGold 100% impaired → PhysicalGold intact, no double-counting, RR recalculated, rebalancer activated

expected.classification: PASS (system handles impairment correctly; anti-double-counting holds)

tests.proof: Pre-impairment: GoldTok contributes $2.6558M to R_a (4.82% of total). Post-impairment: GoldTok eff = $0. PhysicalGold R_a unchanged ($8.0095M before = $8.0095M after) — segregated bar pool, no contagion. GoldTotal weight 20%→15% (no double-counting: GoldTok does not remain in GoldTotal). R_a_after = $52.4242M; RR_after = 97.0819% (-2.9181pp from 102% start). Rebalancer activated → weights renormalized to sum=1.0000 (target weights restored over remaining 95% of reserve value). NOTE: RR_after < 100% — system is insolvent on mark-to-market, but the impairment does NOT propagate to PhysicalGold (anti-double-counting holds), and the rebalancer correctly triggers to restore target weights (requiring external capital).

interpretation: TESTS A/C/D demonstrate that the 102% ceiling (and the thinner 100.4% ceiling) are NOT immune to small losses: a 2% reserve loss, 1% market loss, or 5% custody failure each breach solvency from above-100% starting states. TEST B confirms that proportional redemption preserves the RR ratio exactly (per §44) but does NOT guarantee solvency — the margin above 100% is unchanged and remains thin. TEST E confirms that tokenized-gold impairment does not propagate to physical gold (anti-double-counting holds), GoldTotal is correctly recalculated, RR is correctly recomputed, and the rebalancer is activated to restore target weights.
